tokens_per_ticket.sql: select o.system, count(distinct o.ticket) as tickets, round(avg(t.tokens)) as tokens_per_ticket, round(sum(t.cost), 2) as cost_usd from outcomes o join (select system, ticket, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost from agent_runs group by system, ticket) t using (system, ticket) where o.ticket in (select ticket from outcomes group by ticket having count(*) = (select count(distinct system) from outcomes)) group by o.system order by o.system

repeats_found.sql: select o.system, count(*) filter (where o.correct) as right, count(*) as repeats from outcomes o join tickets k on k.number = o.ticket where k.stream_role = 'repeat' and o.ticket in (select ticket from outcomes group by ticket having count(*) = (select count(distinct system) from outcomes)) group by o.system order by o.system

fix_reused.sql: select l.filed_under as learned_on, array_agg(distinct o.ticket order by o.ticket) as reused_by from learnings l join outcomes o on o.system = l.system and o.known_issue = l.filed_under and o.ticket <> l.ticket where l.system = 'warm' and o.correct group by l.filed_under order by count(distinct o.ticket) desc, l.filed_under

replies_matching.sql: select system, count(*) filter (where resolution = 'match') as matching, count(*) filter (where wrong_claim) as wrong_claims, count(*) as graded from grades group by system order by system
